 suitable safety category

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt ...etc.

Press-on and detaching device, 
 air blower.

Operate the crane, observe and hear the sound 
 of main hoisting, auxiliary hoisting, trolley, and crane travel motors

General 
 cleaning for all motor, and electronic control panel, resistors, by air 
 blower.

Check the 
 motors breakers for main hoisting, auxiliary hoisting, trolley and crane 
 travel and change the motors breakers if necessary.

Check the 
 main power supply line and change if necessary.

Check the 
 contactors, auxiliary contactors, timers and change if necessary.

Place a copy of the field test 
 results at the equipment data file.
